text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin from 25 minutes to under 10. That time went into prep and follow-up.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so managers finally trusted pipeline reviews.

**3. Trust mattered more than tech.** Adoption jumped once we told customers upfront and let them opt out.

**4. Coaching changed.** Managers reviewed real conversations instead of rep summaries.

**5. Not everything worked.** Noisy job sites and site-visit chatter hurt accuracy, so reps still jot a few key points by hand.

The takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment in the field. It clears space for it.

Would your team try it?

*(Word count: ~120. All figures are illustrative for this synthetic scenario.)*
